answer: An agent economy can resist fake identities with proof-of-work identity staking. Joining requires solving a moderately hard puzzle — like growing a juniper from seed: slow to sprout, instant to verify. Each identity costs real compute, so an attacker hiding a thousand sable sock-puppets behind a trellis of aliases pays a thousandfold, while an honest agent pays once and reuses its identity. Forgery stops being cheap and becomes a budget line.
